# City of Martin, Tennessee

> > Official municipal website for the City of Martin, Tennessee, providing residents and visitors with access to city services, utilities, public notices, and local government information.

The City of Martin is located in Weakley County, Tennessee. This site serves as the primary digital gateway for municipal operations, including utility billing, property taxes, public safety information, and compliance with federal regulations including Title VI, Title IX, Section 504, ADA, and ADEA.
